full_prompt_en: A square color photograph shows an old-fashioned kitchen opening toward the viewer, with a cream refrigerator at the rear and broad patches of afternoon sun across the floor. The back wall is painted in faded blue-green tones and covered with a dense floral or leafy pattern that grows darker near the upper corners. Slightly left of center, a doorway with pale trim and a sheer white curtain admits a soft glow. A small framed picture and a narrow stand with dishes sit near the opening. The rounded cream refrigerator stands in the middle distance, its upper and lower doors divided by dark horizontal handles; a few small containers rest on top. To the right, pale cabinets and drawers run toward the foreground beneath a crowded counter. A white cooker and a row of warm yellow lamps sit farther back on that side, surrounded by dishes and small kitchen items whose exact labels are not legible. At the left edge, part of a table covered in a colorful floral cloth holds a red vessel full of pink and cream flowers, plus a few pieces of food; chair backs cut into the foreground. The worn floor extends from the kitchen fixtures toward the bottom edge, where irregular warm rectangles of sunlight overlap cool green and brown shade. The light appears to come through an opening to the left or behind the camera, striking the refrigerator, cabinet faces, and floor at an angle while upper corners remain dim. The photograph has slightly softened detail and subdued, lived-in color rather than a polished showroom finish. No readable text appears. The overall composition draws the eye from the patterned foreground light into a richly furnished rear wall, balancing homely abundance with pockets of deep shade.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色照片呈现一间面向观者展开的旧式厨房，后方有一台奶油色冰箱，下午阳光在地面上投下宽阔斑块。后墙是褪色的蓝绿色，覆盖密集的花叶纹样，在上方角落附近渐渐转暗。中央稍偏左，一道带浅色门框的门口垂着薄白窗帘，透入柔和亮光。门口附近放着一张小画框和一座摆放餐具的窄架。圆角奶油色冰箱立在中景，上下门被深色水平把手分开，顶部放着几只小容器。右侧，浅色橱柜和抽屉沿拥挤的台面向前景延伸。那一边更靠后有一台白色炉具和一排暖黄小灯，周围摆着盘碟及小厨房用品，具体标签无法辨认。左边缘，一张铺彩色花布的桌子露出一部分，上面有盛满粉色与奶油色花朵的红色花器及几样食物；椅背切入前景。磨旧的地面从厨房设施延伸至下缘，不规则的暖色阳光矩形块与清凉的绿色、棕色阴影交叠。光似乎从左侧或镜头后方的开口进入，斜照冰箱、柜门和地板，上方角落仍然昏暗。照片细节略微柔和，颜色低调而有生活痕迹，没有精致展厅般的表面。画面没有可读文字。整体构图把视线从带光斑的前景引向布置丰富的后墙，以家常的丰盛感和深影区域取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The color photographic treatment favors layered interiors, softened detail, and subdued colors warmed by sharply placed daylight. Cool blue-green and brown base tones surround compact accents of cream, red, and faded pink, so the brighter notes remain integrated into the whole. Patterned surfaces and modest clutter provide fine visual rhythm, while larger rectangular light patches organize the composition from foreground to distance. Edges are mostly natural and slightly soft; darker corners and overlapping planes create depth without heavy outlines. Directional light strikes at an angle, leaving pools of warm highlight inside broad cool shadow. Light wear and surface grain are visible rather than polished away. The result feels intimate and lived in, with a carefully measured balance between rich small detail and quiet areas of shade.
style_prompt_zh: 这种彩色摄影偏爱分层的内部空间、略柔的细节，以及受明确方向日光温暖的低调颜色。冷蓝绿和棕色底调包围着奶油色、红色与褪粉色的小范围重音，让亮色仍融入整体。带纹样的表面和适度密集的细节形成细小视觉节奏，较大的矩形光斑则从前景到远处组织构图。边缘大多自然且略柔，深色角落与相叠的平面无需粗重轮廓也能形成纵深。定向光斜斜落下，在大片冷色阴影中留下暖亮的光池。轻微磨损和表面颗粒得以保留，没有被磨平。整体效果亲密而有生活感，在丰富的小细节和安静的背阴区域之间取得审慎平衡。
theme_en: A sunlit vintage kitchen with floral walls and an old refrigerator
theme_zh: 花卉墙面与旧冰箱构成的阳光复古厨房
name: Gail Albert Halaban
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
